CustomField.description: Where the form shows each option's description from Picklist Option Settings. Empty means Auto: lists, survey buttons and visual pickers show it under each option; button groups and badges show it in a popup when the respondent hovers over or focuses the option (a tap on a phone); the standard picklist and multi-select combobox show it inside the dropdown menu; path and dual listbox show the chosen options' descriptions under the field. Below Option, Hover Bubble and Below Field override Auto; a choice the display type cannot draw falls back to Auto.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Where option descriptions appear on the form. Leave empty for Auto, which picks the best place for the field's display type.
CustomField.label: Option Description Display
